_comment: Real advertisers. Each entry maps slots to a PNG next to this file ('image' for the long boards, drawn 4:1, and optionally 'image_square' for the square ones). Selectors: all, courtside, table_side, far_side, baseline, baseline_west, baseline_east, centre, padding, table, or a slot number (0-5 far sideline as the camera sees it, 6-11 near sideline, 12-13 west baseline, 14-15 east baseline, 16 centre circle, 17-18 basket padding, 19 scorer's table). 'clubs' (team or arena names) is optional. The first matching entry wins; slots no entry names show the in-game sponsor. 'vector' and 'vector_square' (triangle files made by tools/board_mesh.py) draw the board as geometry in 'ink' on 'bg', which stays sharp at any distance; the PNGs are the fallback.
